execution.ref: tests/invariants/test_attack_store_unreachable.py on main 992d046b in a venv synced with the contract-authority lane's groups (dev, chain, archive); fixed on claude/fix-attack-invariant-no-numpy
execution.description: Ran the attack-store unreachability invariant (merged in #563) the way the Contract and authority acceptance lane runs tests/invariants, with no numerical stack installed, then imported each miner module alone to find what needed numpy.

expected: The invariant passes in every lane that runs tests/invariants: the canonical shards and the contract-authority lane that decision-only and docs-only pull requests get.
observed: Two tests failed with ModuleNotFoundError for numpy: the store-name check imported the store (knowledge.py imports development_session.data, which imports numpy), and the runtime import check imported the miner modules, 26 of 32 of which import numpy on load through development_session.data or measurement_runtime.model. The pull request that added the test changed runtime code, so only the canonical shards, which install numpy, ran it; every later decision-only or docs-only pull request failed the contract lane.
keep: A test under tests/invariants runs in two lanes with different installs: the canonical shards (every group) and the contract-authority lane (dev, chain, archive only). Run a new invariant in a venv synced with the contract lane's groups before merging it.
Keep the runtime import check alongside the static import walk: a store import by a name built at run time is invisible to the walk and only the runtime check catches it.
change: The store-name check reads STORE_DIRNAME and SCHEMA_PREFIX from knowledge.py's source and requires each to be bound once, to a string literal, so the value read is the value the module holds.

The runtime import check's fresh interpreter supplies an inert stand-in for numpy only when numpy is not installed (its finder sits last on sys.meta_path); any other missing module still fails, and where numpy is installed the test asserts nothing was stubbed.
New specimens: a store import by a run-time name fails the import check with and without numpy, and a renamed, computed or rebound store name fails the name check.
